name: PT Bank Ina Perdana Tbk
summary: PT Bank Ina Perdana Tbk provides general and digital banking products and services for individuals, MSMEs, and corporations in Indonesia. It operates through Marketing and Loans, Treasury, and Trade Finance segments. The company offers current and savings accounts; DHE SDA and foreign currency current accounts; margin and consumer fund depository bank segregated accounts; customer fund current and savings accounts; DHE SDA savings and foreign currency savings accounts; time deposits; DHE SDA deposits; foreign currency time and DHE deposits; digital savings accounts; and cash reward time deposits.
